text: A module shall be the unit of source ownership, separate compilation, and lifecycle registration. Its publishable source shall begin with one explicit nonempty NUL-free UTF-8 identity string, before target/imports. Identity shall compare exact decoded scalar sequences, without case/path/Unicode normalization, filename inference, or version-range resolution.
